from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u084/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ca63d1db.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    divider_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    if divider_rows:
        line = divider_rows[0]
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2, 8)]
        if not cells:
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
        out[line] = [2] * w
        top = line + 1
        for r,c in cells:
            nr = top + r-r0
            if nr < h:
                out[nr][c] = grid[r][c]
        marker = top + (r1-r0) + 1
        if marker < h:
            out[marker] = [8] * w
        return out
    if divider_cols:
        line = divider_cols[0]
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2, 8)]
        if not cells:
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
        for r in range(h): out[r][line] = 2
        left = line + 1
        for r,c in cells:
            nc = left + c-c0
            if nc < w: out[r][nc] = grid[r][c]
        marker = left + (c1-c0) + 1
        if marker < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][marker] = 8
        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''
p.write_text(source)
